# Generated File Policy

Source of truth: all `.tsp` sources under `contracts/`, rooted at
`contracts/main.tsp`, plus `tspconfig.yaml`.

Regeneration: `npm run generate`.

Freshness: `npm run check:generated` verifies source and output SHA-256 values
recorded in `generated/manifest.json`. `npm run verify:generated` checks the
committed snapshot, regenerates artifacts without rewriting the manifest, and
checks the regenerated bytes against that snapshot. This is the CI/signoff
command, so stale output cannot be silently repaired during validation.

Release inclusion: generated JSON Schema, OpenAPI, TypeScript declarations, and
the manifest are committed and included with releases because downstream
consumers do not run the generator.

Editing: never hand-edit `generated/`. Change the authoritative `.tsp` sources
or generator configuration and regenerate.
